items.title: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard
NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3 . 5 Lightning 30B open AI model and NeMo Switchyard for agentic AI

brief: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard is the one topic Wednesday, August 12's feeds agree on — it surfaced on gdelt-ai, hackernews, huggingface at the same minute. Builders spent the day on cathrynlavery/diagram-design. On Steam, Counter-Strike 2 drew the biggest crowd.
